items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: I've been friends with them a long time.

ctx.x: Willie. Willie. Poisey. Well, them two anyhow. I've been friends with them a long time. My brother. They're Humphreys. Where you work on? Who are you? No, I'm freelancing for New Orleans Magazine.
